Threat description: Credential stuffing or repeated password guesses lead to unauthorized login
Likely impact: Unauthorized access to user accounts and fictional operational records
Proposed mitigation: Password hashing; rate limiting; failed-login lockout; secure session cookies

Threat description: Team member invokes manager/admin endpoints directly without the correct role
Likely impact: Unauthorized account or role changes and modification of records
Proposed mitigation: Enforce server-side RBAC on every protected API route and object; test negative authorization cases

Affected component or data flow / STRIDE: Flask input validation → business services → SQLite
Threat description: Malicious form data or injection attempt alters queries or corrupts route/defect records
Likely impact: Compromised record integrity and inaccurate dashboard trends
Proposed mitigation: Validate types/ranges; parameterized SQL; server-side constraints; reject malformed requests

Threat description: Unauthorized or forged edit/delete request modifies defect or route records
Likely impact: Loss of records and unreliable operational performance analysis
Proposed mitigation: Authorize action and target record before each write/delete; transactions; log changes

Threat description: Stolen or unattended session is reused to impersonate an authenticated user
Likely impact: Unauthorized actions without needing the user password
Proposed mitigation: HttpOnly Secure SameSite cookies; idle expiration; logout invalidation; CSRF defenses for state-changing actions

Affected component or data flow / STRIDE: Flask API routes and login endpoint
Threat description: High-volume requests overload a single-instance application and prevent normal access
Likely impact: Temporary loss of dashboard availability and delayed review of metrics
Proposed mitigation: Per-client/IP rate limits; request size limits; timeouts and monitoring

Affected component or data flow / STRIDE: Business service → audit logger → protected logs (TB-2→TB-3)
Threat description: Privileged user deletes or changes records without a reliable audit trail
Likely impact: Inability to attribute changes or investigate suspicious activity
Proposed mitigation: Capture who/what/when and outcome of every sensitive action; restrict log changes and review events

Threat description: Detailed errors reveal database structure, stack traces, or server paths
Likely impact: Attackers gain technical information for future exploitation
Proposed mitigation: Generic client error responses; detailed restricted server-side logs; disable debug in deployment

Threat description: Misconfigured file permissions or exported backups expose stored accounts or records
Likely impact: Exposure of password hashes, permissions, audit events, or fictional performance records
Proposed mitigation: Restrict file/backups permissions; encrypt sensitive backups; avoid committing database files; protect secrets

Affected component or data flow / STRIDE: Report export → local file storage → browser
Threat description: User downloads a generated report beyond their assigned permissions or sees another user’s output
Likely impact: Unauthorized disclosure of route/defect reporting information
Proposed mitigation: Authorize exports per role; protect export endpoints; avoid public file paths; apply retention limits
